beats.text: Linux was announced as a hobby that would not be big.
beats.note: Torvalds wrote on 25 August 1991: just a hobby, won't be big and professional like gnu.

beats.text: He wanted to call it Freax.
beats.note: A mix of free, freak and x, as an allusion to Unix.

beats.name: Ari Lemmke
beats.role: Volunteer admin of the Helsinki University of Technology FTP server. He renamed the directory Linux.

beats.note: It was uploaded to ftp.funet.fi, in the directory Lemmke had named.

beats.text: The name of the world's biggest open source project came from a server admin.

beats.line: Tech history is full of accidents.
